candidateAudit.title: Discover the secrets of the Andean Highlands: Mashua | Grilled Mussels | Ají Panca | Whey | Sea Fennel This dish highlights Mashua, a slightly peppery, earthy Andean root that has
candidateAudit.text: Discover the secrets of the Andean Highlands: Mashua | Grilled Mussels | Ají Panca | Whey | Sea Fennel This dish highlights Mashua, a slightly peppery, earthy Andean root that has been cultivated for centuries on the misty terraces of Peru, Ecuador, and Bolivia—once a staple of Incan warriors, prized for both its bold flavor and medicinal strength. First, a silky mashua purée with smoky BBQ mussels, a delicate whey emulsion, and briny sea fennel. The sweet smokiness of ají panca ties everything together, while the whey, a byproduct of our home-made cream cheese, adds balance and depth. Alongside, a crispy mashua latke, served with a rich smoked mussel emulsion and queso fresco. A celebration of the Andean Highlands—earthy, smoky, creamy, and bold. 🍷In the glass, we add some spiciness and depth: Clipeo 100% Maturana Blanca is a rare, full-bodied white wine from Rioja, vinified in oak for richness, with bright citrus, stone fruit, and saline minerality—its depth enhances the smoky mussels and creamy whey emulsion, while its acidity balances the dish’s richness. clipeo_wines Feral #2 is a naturally fermented root juice with deep earthy notes, gentle spice, and a refreshing acidity, mirroring the peppery intensity of mashua and the smokiness of ají panca while adding complexity to the dish’s layered flavors. feral_drinks . . 📸 by christianpiwowar . . #zsomrestaurant #zsomexperience #finediningvienna #bistronomie #latinfusion #latinochefs #michelinstardining #vienna #visitaustria🇦🇹 #fusioncuisine #casualfinedining

candidateAudit.text: Curiosity is the foundation of creativity. Discover our take on Dobladitas: Cabbage | Chard | Huitlacoche | Candied Sunflower seeds | Fermented beetroot reduction | Lovage Oil Our 1st dish after the welcome bites takes your taste buds on a journey from fruity to earthy, acidic to umami. For us, this course is symbolic for what we would like you to experience at Z’SOM. It showcases the seasonal ingredients we are working with at the end of winter in Austria, the Latinamerican surprise you will always find in our dishes and the eagerness to listen and learn. The inspiration for the fermented beetroot reduction actually came from a chat with our dear Chef de Partie katarzyna_kulczyk who told us how beetroots are fermented in her homecountry Poland. She generously shared her grandmother’s recipe with us which we tweaked a little to add a fruity yet tangy base for our Dobladitas. Together with the soothing huitlacoche, the crunchiness of the cabbage, the slightly spicy-sweet sunflower seeds and the herbal homeliness of lovage it creates a very different kind of comfort food. 🍷We pair this dish with 2 of our favorites: Lichtenberger&Gonzalez, our all time favorite winery. Their Pet Nat Non Vintage is 100% Blaufränkisch. Its fruitiness, earthiness and legendary minerality complement the dish on each level. lichtenbergergonzalez If you opt for the alcohol-free pairing, you will be treated to L’Antidote from Domaine des Grottes in Beaujolais. candidateAudit.text: let’s talk about thed0ughkn0t and littlefox_play upcoming workshop in march ❤️ Bre@thplay Pr3dicaments on 8th of march ❤️ This class explores controlled breathwork and dynamic positioning on the floor and in partial suspensions. Rather than focusing on strict visual symmetry, we aim for harmony and balance. Rotating the neck, shoulders, and hips in different directions creates physically demanding shapes that enhance the model’s form. We will work with tension and endurance, designing challenges that encourage the rope bottom to navigate discomfort and control. This is an evolving interaction where the bottom seeks moments of ease, while the top carefully guides the experience, shaping a compelling exchange of movement and response. We’ll begin with open postures and back bends, pulling the shoulders back to create elongation. Then, we’ll transition into more compact, folded shapes where the knees and chest come together. Each set of positions presents unique challenges for both the model and the rigger, refining technique and connection throughout the session. -> questions? are you interested to come but not sure of your level? or are you still looking for a partner? text us 🦋

candidateAudit.text: we are happy to announce that our beginner workshop will happen on 30.11 ✨ The aim of this workshop is to teach the basics of rope handling and important safety topics regarding bondage and rope. been to our jams but it seems like you’re not progressing enough to really have fun with rope? want to freshen up your memory after a longer break from tying? or dive into topics like nerves or more complicated ties? then this workshop is for you :) this time we are offering three teachers plus several space holders and models. a whole day of guiding and helping you get to a level where you can continue exploring on your own. the workshop should make you confident enough to start exploring and experimenting on your own from then onwards. 🫶 we are offering a fair price that is for couples so please partner up before signing on, if you want to attend but don’t have a tying partner please let us know aswell so we can try and help you. if you want to attend but have a low income please let us know we can see if we can offer low income tickets. :) more questions? write us sign up and tickets via libelle website, link in bio ❤️❤️❤️ photo by erfanthejoyful ✨🙏

candidateAudit.text: Wir verabschieden uns bald von der Schafkaesesaison 2022! Es ist immer ein Zeichen fuer uns - von einfach: Wie der Lauf der Natur mit den Tieren und der Landwirtschaft zusammen hängt. Es ist ok nicht immer alles verfügbar zu haben. Es macht es so zu einer RIESEN großen Freude wenn dann wieder alle Schafsmilchsprodukte ( so Ende Februar ... ca... Maerz) in der Theke sind! So lassen wir alle Milch und Kraft aller 🐑 nachkommen & auch wieder Kraft zu tanken fuer die naechste Saison!!! 🐑 Tolle Saison!!! Danke an unsere Lieferanten milchmaederl & nuart_vulgohafner #nolovenocheese #annaammarkt #kernmeidling #marktstand #saison #wienermaerkte #meidlingermarkt #schafkaese #handwerk #kaese #artisancheese #laufderdinge #natur #biolandwirtschaft #dankbar 📸: _helenawimmer studiodeluxe.photo 🍂

candidateAudit.text: Es gibt viele Herstellungsarten/Konservierungsarten / Veredelungen bei Fleisch. Kochen, suren, trocknen... die Selchwürstel vom #biohoflabonca sind geselcht. Ohne Phosphate, ohne Citrate, ohne Nitrit. Die "Solo" Linie vom Biohof Labonca - ohne Zusätze. So ohne Zusätze ist echt eine Kunst... es gut hinzubekommen oder?! Da bedarf es schon an viel Fleischerhandwerk. ( nicht nur) . Ihr könnt auch fuer diese handwerkliche Fleischerei voten bei falstaff.magazin oder ihr kommt vorbei und macht euch ein echtes Bild davon was "a echte gsechte' Wurst is". https://www.falstaff.at/nd/voting-die-beliebtesten-fleischhauer-oesterreichs-2022/ #biohoflabonca #bio #artgerecht #tierwohl #nitritfrei #phosphatfrei #hamdwerk #fleischerhandwerk #geselcht #labonca #annaammarkt #meidlingermarkt #kernmeidling #biofleisch #wenigeristmehr 📸 _helenawimmer studiodeluxe.photo 🐖

candidateAudit.text: Fuer ein Hauch süden Gefühl in Wien, sorgt diese französische Öl Manufaktur. alolivier1822 ist in kleinen Mengen zu erwerben. So bleibt es frisch. Ob das natürlich aromatisierte Olivenöl mit Basilikum oder das Zitrone Ingwer ist. Es sorgt fuer eine Escapade in die mediterannée. Diese Assemblagen sind ein must, alle 🥬Salate 🥬 in den Gärten - warten nur drauf. Rann ans Dressing - vive la bonne vinaigrette. 💡Tipp: vorerst Zitrone oder Essig nachher das Öl / oder ihr zaubert überhaupt ein extra Dressing in einer Schale. candidateAudit.text: Wenn alles in Butter ist dann ist es gut! Sagt ma auf Deutsch. ⭐️ Meine Erinnerung marcel_et_anna an Butter ist schon im kleinen Volksschulalter auf pariser Maerketen gekommen!
